{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Exclude QA orders and refunded orders
# QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~((df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99) | (df['status'] == 'refunded'))]

# Check the final population
print(f'Final number of orders (after removing QA and refunded): {len(df_clean)}')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))"}
